description: Get a unified risk assessment for any address: combines contract security scan, token approval risks, and market liquidation stress into one composite risk score. Scope: composite decision view for one wallet or contract, combining contract, approval, and liquidation-risk signals. Use this when the agent wants one prioritized address risk summary. Use security.contract.scan, token.approval, or wallet.credit_score when it needs one focused dimension instead.
